function.name: SIGNAL
function.param:
Type of signal to send to a process. It can be one of the following predefined constants:
S_KILL
S_WAKEUP
S_SLEEP
S_FREEZE
S_KILL_TREE
S_WAKEUP_TREE
S_SLEEP_TREE
S_FREEZE_TREE
function.abstract: It changes the state of a process or group of processes

description.p: This function changes the state of a process, or if this function recives like parameter one of the constants finished in _TREE, of a process and all its sons and descending.

There are four possible states for a process:
WAKEUP: the state by default. The process is executed normally each frame, and if his variable has any value, it is drawn a graph in screen in the coordinates specified by its local variables and .
FREEZE: the process is stopped, his code is not executed each frame. However, his graph is drawn normally.
SLEEP: the process is sleeping. His code is not executed, but his graph is not drawn in screen.
KILL: the process is dead. If this frame has still not been executed, will not be executed nor will be in screen. Before starting the next frame, the process will not occupy memory and it will disappear of the internal list.

The function SIGNAL can change in any moment the state of a process or of its sons. The changes do not affect to the current process until his execution arrives to the setence FRAME. In the same way, the father process (and the rest of predecessors) will not be affected by the changes until sentence FRAME.
